db_authority: DB59 frozen but no DB59/source-script free text in the fresh task

prior_result_boundary.rule: R2 is a new prospective replication. R1 remains FAIL and is not pooled into a PASS claim.

hypotheses.H1: On a fresh source-free whole episode, unchanged I4H conservative rerendering produces Treatment-Control whole-episode mean delta >= +0.30 with no integrity failure.
hypotheses.H2: LOW and STANDARD interventions remain nonharmful at whole-episode scale while ABSTAIN remains byte-identical.
hypotheses.H3: The surface-targeted mechanism is positive without loss on protected semantic/continuity axes.

fresh_task_rule: Create a completely new synthetic series/episode, different setting, characters, central problem, relationship geometry and scene material from I4I R1. Do not reuse Maru Station people, Night Maru festival, electrical-load plot, R1 dialogue, or R1 scene briefs.
plan_rule: Before any Control prose, freeze Series State, Episode Synopsis, Sequence Plan and Scene Plan. Control and Treatment consume the exact same frozen plan byte-for-byte.

policy_lock.decision_rule: Use the existing I4H Recovery R3 selector unchanged; no threshold/routing edits from R1 are permitted.
policy_lock.LOW: existing Recovery R3 LOW constraints unchanged
policy_lock.STANDARD: existing Recovery R3 STANDARD constraints unchanged

generation_order: Generate Control once with I4H revision disabled and seal all scene/episode SHA256 values.
Only after Control seal, profile six dimensions and freeze selector decisions.
Generate Treatment using unchanged I4H Recovery R3 policy; every failed guard falls back to Control.
Seal Treatment and run masked same-agent Development/Preformal evaluation because independent human/OpenAI Live is unavailable in this environment.
Seal score hash before opening A/B map.

legacy_primary_gates_unchanged.episode_axis_nonloss: Treatment >= Control on at least 9 of 12 axes

secondary_mechanism_diagnostics.rule: Secondary mechanism results cannot compensate for failure of the unchanged legacy primary gate.

claim_boundary.active_engine_promotion: not from R2 alone; requires all subsequent governance gates
